notes: gopher64 keeps its settings in ~/.config/gopher64/config.json, which emuopts cannot patch (no JSON format): every option here is a command-line argument, applied for the run and leaving the file alone (upscaling and the rest stay in gopher64's own GUI, Open).
Widescreen has no off argument: --widescreen is a flag, and without it config.json's own value applies, so "Emulator's setting" is the off.

options.label: Widescreen (16:9)
options.description: Render 16:9 instead of the N64's 4:3. Games without a widescreen mode are stretched.

options.label: CPU overclocking
options.description: Emulate an overclocked N64 CPU: smoother in games that slow down on real hardware, but it can break timing-sensitive games.
